subject: accounting
objective: Break-even against an expected volume, for the margin of safety
instruction: A subscription software business in a mid-sized city charges 80 USD per month per subscriber. The variable cost of serving a subscriber is 20 USD a month and fixed costs are 24000 USD a month. The sales team expects to add 600 subscribers this month. Required: report the break-even quantity, the contribution margin per subscriber, the expected revenue at the expected volume, the margin of safety in units and the margin of safety as a percentage of the expected volume, and the revenue at the break-even point.
